claims.reason: Direct partition by support membership proves I_(T-v)=I_H+zI_R; partition by leaf membership proves alpha(T)=alpha(H)+1. Coefficient comparison gives the identity for signed integer ranks. Independent subset counts passed 358242 bounded checks.

claims.reason: The algebra gives the exact conditional implication. No transfer from x(T)'s eligibility condition to the needed H_v coefficient bound is supplied; the pointwise claim and primary theorem stay unresolved.
